node.title: WCL ell=1 weight-6 pair-Heron norm router
node.statement: For any pairing of six square roots, the 32-factor unsigned sign product Psi_6 is the product of eight explicit Heron factors H(U,V,W)=U^2+V^2+W^2-2UV-2UW-2VW. Equivalently Psi_6 is the norm of this six-term polynomial through three independent quadratic pair-product extensions. Each Heron factor owns exactly four global-sign classes, so the eight factors preserve the exact union of supporting rational primes. No official prime exclusion is claimed.
